_note: Regions for the DAILY 'tomorrow's sky' digest. Korean display names live here (data, not .ts source, per the i18n no-Korean-in-source rule). `owmQuery` is the representative city used for the OpenWeatherMap forecast lookup. The order in this file is irrelevant: the published digest shuffles regions per day with NO weighting (deterministic from the date, so it is stable within a day but no region is ever listed first by default). Kept deliberately few (6 broad regions) so the evening digest stays a calm read, not a wall of cities.
